# 楞伽經玄義

**Volume:** X17

**Byline:** 明 智旭撰述
**Dynasty:** 明
**Date:** 1368–1644
**Juans:** 1

- 智旭 (A001257)

## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

X328 in one fascicle is [智旭](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%99%BA%E6%97%AD) (Ǒuyì Zhìxù, 1599–1655)'s *xuányì* on *[Léngqiéābáduōluó bǎo jīng 楞伽阿跋多羅寶經](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0327)* (T670). The work is paired with [X329](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0346) (the *yìshū*) — together constituting [智旭](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%99%BA%E6%97%AD)'s mature *Laṅkāvatāra* commentary in the Tiāntái commentarial pair-genre of *xuányì* + *wénjù* / *yìshū*.

**Abstract**

The Taishō / *Xuzangjing* witness preserves the head-line: 支那藕益沙門　釋智旭　撰述 ("composed by the Chinese Ǒu-yì *bhikṣu* Shì Zhìxù"). Date bracket follows [智旭](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%99%BA%E6%97%AD)'s late productive period at Língfēngsì 靈峯寺 (1635–1655). The opening of the work captures the doctrinal programme tightly: "the sage's Self-Awakening Wisdom (自覺聖智), the Mind of First-Truth (第一義心), is not communicated by names and forms; how could it be entered through speculation? Depending on defilement-and-purity, [the sūtra] divides the *five dharmas*; *dharma* by *dharma* is fundamentally true. By delusion-and-awakening, [it] discriminates the *three natures*; nature by nature is essentially without nature. From the differentiation of substance-and-function in delusion, the *eight kinds of consciousness* are established — but consciousness is like a sky-flower. Where understanding manifests partial-and-perfect principle, the *twofold no-self* is named — but [no-]self is like the rabbit's horn. Therefore: all Buddha-speech transmits only this Mind; all Buddha-Mind seals only this speech."

This is a classic statement of [智旭](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%99%BA%E6%97%AD)'s integrative doctrinal position: Yogācāra (the eight-consciousness scheme), Madhyamaka (the analogies of sky-flower and rabbit's horn for the unreality of conventional designations), Tathāgatagarbha (the *zìjué shèngzhì* / *Self-Awakening Wisdom*), and Chán-school (mind-seal) all read together through the sūtra's own structure. As a programmatic *xuányì* it shapes the reading of the parent sūtra in [X329](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0346) and beyond.

Related canonical texts: parent sūtra [KR6i0327](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0327) (楞伽阿跋多羅寶經 / T670); paired commentary [KR6i0346](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0346) (楞伽經義疏 / X329).
